definition: A sequence in which each term is the one before multiplied by the same non-zero number, such as $3, 6, 12, 24, \dots$
The fixed number $r$ that each term of a geometric sequence is multiplied by to give the next, found as $r = \frac{u_{2}}{u_{1}}$.
The sum of the terms of a geometric sequence, such as $4 + 12 + 36 + \dots$
